start_date.description: UTC date and time in the format 2017-01-25T00:00:00Z. Any data before this date will not be replicated.
start_date.title: Start Date

lookback_window.description: How far into the past to look for messages in threads, default is 0 days
lookback_window.title: Threads Lookback window (Days)

join_channels.description: Whether to join all channels or to sync data only from channels the bot is already in.  If false, you''ll need to manually add the bot to all the channels from which you''d like to sync messages.
join_channels.title: Join all channels

include_private_channels.description: Whether to read information from private channels that the bot is already in.  If false, only public channels will be read.  If true, the bot must be manually added to private channels.
include_private_channels.title: Include private channels

include_archived_channels.description: Whether to include archived channels in the sync. When disabled (default), archived channels are excluded from the Slack API response, reducing the number of API calls for downstream streams such as channel_messages, threads, and channel_members. Enable this option if you need to sync data from archived channels.
include_archived_channels.title: Include archived channels

channel_filter.description: A channel name list (without leading '#' char) which limit the channels from which you'd like to sync. Empty list means no filter.
channel_filter.title: Channel name filter

threads_ignore_no_replies.description: When enabled, the threads stream will skip messages that have no replies (reply_count is 0, null, or absent), reducing the number of API calls. Disabled by default to make Threads stream contain unthreaded messages in its records.
threads_ignore_no_replies.title: Ignore messages with no replies in threads stream

client_id.description: Slack client_id. See our docs if you need help finding this id.
client_id.title: Client ID

client_secret.description: Slack client_secret. See our docs if you need help finding this secret.
client_secret.title: Client Secret

access_token.description: Slack access_token. See our docs if you need help generating the token.
access_token.title: Access token

api_token.description: A Slack bot token (xoxb-). See the docs for instructions on how to generate it.
api_token.title: Bot Token

credentials.description: Choose how to authenticate into Slack
credentials.title: Authentication mechanism

num_workers.description: The number of worker threads to use for the sync.
num_workers.title: Number of concurrent threads

channel_messages_window_size.description: The size (in days) of the date window that will be used while syncing data from the channel messages stream. A smaller window will allow for greater parallelization when syncing records, but can lead to rate limiting errors.
channel_messages_window_size.title: Channel messages date window size (in days)

concurrency.description: Maximum number of streams read at the same time. Slack rate limits each API method separately, so reading the streams concurrently (users, channels, channel members, channel messages and threads each use their own method) shortens a sync without hitting the limits sooner. Defaults to the legacy 'num_workers' value, or 2.
concurrency.title: Concurrency

checkpoint_target_interval_seconds.description: How often (in seconds) a stream should checkpoint its progress, when possible. Long streams (channel messages, threads) save their state at about this interval, so that an interrupted sync resumes where it stopped. Defaults to 300.
checkpoint_target_interval_seconds.title: Checkpoint Target Time Interval (Advanced)
